abstract: Fifty six patients with yolk sac tumor are registered in the "Instituto Nacional de Enfermedades Neoplásicas" (Lima-Peru), from 1952-1980: 48.22% were less than 2 years of age; 51.78% were beyond that age.- Seventeen patients survived 3 years post diagnosis: 44% when patients less than 2 years of age and 17.2% when over two years of age. 25.9% of the patients less than 2 years of age were found to have metastases whereas 48.5% when over 2 years of age. 21/56 already had metastases when first seen. All tumors were greater than or equal to 3 cm. in diameter when first seen. Metastases were found in 38% of cases when tumors were less than or equal to 6 cm., compared to 61.9% of cases in which tumors exceeded 6 cm. 51.8% of clinical stage I survived 3 years without evidence of disease; 14.3% when stage II while none survived at clinical stage IV. It is to be expected that young patients who survive 3 years after diagnosis and treatment will not suffer a recurrence of the disease.
abstract_ja: リマ（ペルー）の国立腫瘍研究所（Instituto Nacional de Enfermedades Neoplásicas）に1952年から1980年にかけて登録された卵黄嚢腫瘍患者56例のうち、48.22%は2歳未満、51.78%は2歳以上であった。診断後3年生存したのは17例で、2歳未満では44%、2歳以上では17.2%であった。2歳未満の患者の25.9%、2歳以上の患者の48.5%に転移が認められた。21/56例は初診時にすでに転移を有していた。初診時の腫瘍径はすべて3cm以上であった。腫瘍径が6cm以下の場合は38%に転移を認め、6cmを超える場合は61.9%に転移を認めた。臨床病期Iの患者の51.8%は病勢の証拠なく3年間生存し、病期IIでは14.3%、病期IVでは全例が生存しなかった。診断と治療後3年生存した若年患者は、再発しないと予想される。
